statement:
I'll look up M. Reyes's account access record first to see what status should be applied.
The record shows M. Reyes's account status is currently open but the employee left yesterday, so the account access should be closed on the last day of employment.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the record's "open, extended for 12 months" status conflicts with the rule, stating "the account access should be closed on the last day of employment."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
